fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x12AA270 allocates 0x30 and zeroes a HashSet; destructor thunk_FUN_140582ad0 (trivial keys). Windows gui::registration::VMPlayerRegistrationSystem remote-player step bg3.exe+0x12A8B60 (component via storage index DAT_146320398, getter bg3.exe+0x12A95C0) clears the set (buckets memset -1, sizes +0x1C/+0x2C zeroed), then for every matching query row calls gui::registration::VMRemotePlayerDataSingletonComponent::CreateVM(entity) and inserts that same entity handle with bg3.exe+0x721030 (8-byte keys).

summary: Client UI registry: remote-player entities whose VMPlayer view-model was created this frame (counterpart of VMLocalPlayerRegisteredSingletonComponent). Singleton from game start; empty in single player.
second_pass: Windows bg3.exe+0x12A8B60 (found through the storage index DAT_146320398) inserts each entity it creates a VMPlayer view-model for into this set, so the HashSet<EntityHandle> is now established from Windows code rather than from the local-player twin.
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
